- Pushed commit 2c7679b to origin/master and ran .ralph/task_switch.sh.
- task_switch updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done, sent its summary email, and printed the known rm error for missing .ralph/current_task.txt.
- Next: start from the freshly switched Ralph task state; the worktree now contains the expected post-switch .ralph bookkeeping changes.

- Started by loading the previous progress log, the improve-code-boundaries skill, the current git status, and a full src/tests file listing.
- Progress read returned no visible prior notes; git status shows existing .ralph task/progress modifications already in the worktree.
- Next I need to inspect found_smells as required by the skill, pick one concrete boundary issue, and carry it through lint, tests, commit, push, and task switch.

- Confirmed the skill queue is empty, so I moved on to selecting a fresh boundary smell inside src/tests.
- Rejected src/api/worker.rs because the smell-9 example from the skill is already implemented there.
- Next I am proving a single-use helper boundary with the compiler so I can inline it cleanly and then run lint/tests/commit/push/task switch.

- Proved smell-10 on src/postgres_managed_conf.rs by temporarily renaming render_managed_primary_conninfo and running make check.
- Compiler showed exactly one production call site, so I inlined the primary_conninfo+passfile rendering into the replica branch, deleted the helper, and re-ran make check successfully.
- Next I need to run the required make lint and make test, then commit all changes including .ralph, push, and switch tasks.

- make lint passed after the one-file helper cleanup.
- make test passed with 243 tests passing; nextest reported 5 leaky tests in the existing suite.
- Next I need to file that leaky-test issue as a bug per repo instructions, then commit all changes including .ralph, push, and switch tasks.

- The leak reported by nextest is already tracked in existing bug task files, so I did not create a duplicate bug.
- I am staging the code change plus the current .ralph bookkeeping changes and committing them now.
- Next I need to push master and run .ralph/task_switch.sh in that order.
